LOL, I was born and raised in midwest Brazil. Still live here. This place is usually warm and it never snows. The lowest temperature we've ever experienced here was 8 celsius, in the past.  but over the years we were used to expect for a well balanced weather between middle October and the following April. Also, during this period of the year it is normal to be raining. But year after year the average temperature is rising. And in 2018, particularly, we're almost at christmas and the weather is way far hotter than the normal (Today: 29 celsius in the evening / 19:30 pm). The UV rate today is at 15, considered at extreme level. The water volume of many rivers is decreasing year after year, and people has suffering with lack of pipered water in many days of the year. Sun power is like 200% of the normal and it's been hard to live here without using an air conditioner or sunscreen many hours a day. No, the world isn't getting warmer, definitely. We should just rake the floor of the forest.
